marco-barcena.text: (2022) A lead proponent of Bell Gardens' permanent rent stabilization ordinance (cap of 4% or half of CPI, plus just-cause eviction rules), which passed 5-0; said 'Thank you for having the courage to stand up for the community.'

source.title: Downey Latino News: Bell Gardens caps rent increases at 4% (Aug 26, 2022)

marco-barcena.text: Part of the 4-1 council vote (De Leon Sanchez abstaining) endorsing Prop. 50 redistricting (Oct 2025); as mayor called it a chance 'to defend ourselves against this dictatorship.'

source.title: The SELA Sun: Bell Gardens City Council backs Prop. 50 (Nov 2, 2025)

marco-barcena.text: Signed the official ballot argument for Measure BG, a quarter-cent sales tax (June 2026); in a pre-election video said 'for this tax measure everyone is on the same page.'

marco-barcena.text: As mayor, introduced the motion (passed unanimously, Oct 2025) renaming the city's new aquatics center the 'Dreamers Aquatic Center,' saying 'we're in a very difficult time in our history as a country' and 'the theme of hope is extremely important.'
